What members get

  • Fortnightly or monthly valets, at your home or workplace
  • Discounts on other Rebel services [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: what the discounts are]
  • Priority access to dates and times we don't offer to other customers
  • A car that's kept clean all year, rather than cleaned once and left

How to join

  1. Send an enquiry Use the quote form or WhatsApp, and tell us the car and your postcode.
  2. Agree a schedule We'll be in touch to arrange a time and date for your first clean and the visits after it.
  3. First clean Charged at the Full Valet price (£65), to bring the car up to a standard we can maintain.
  4. Regular visits From then on, £35 a visit, fortnightly or monthly.

Who it suits

  • Anyone who wants a clean car without booking each time
  • Cars that have just had a ceramic coating and need careful maintenance washes
  • Busy households and people who can't get to a car wash

Rebel VIP questions

Why is the first clean charged at the Full Valet price?

Regular maintenance valets keep a car at a standard. They aren't designed to bring a neglected car up to it. The first clean gets the car to a level we can then maintain on every visit.

How much does it cost?

Your first clean is charged at the Full Valet price (£65). After that, each visit is £35. Fortnightly works out at about £70 a month; monthly is £35 a month.
